title: Art Card: Willem de Kooning and Elaine de Kooning, 1953 (Hand Signed by BOTH Willem de Kooning and Elaine de Kooning) from the Dan Pope collection
medium: Offset lithograph postcard of Hans Namuth photograph (Signed by both Elaine and Willem de Kooning)

events.n: the photograph reproduced on the card
events.q: This postcard depicts Hans Namuth's famous 1953 photograph of Elaine de Kooning and Willem de Kooning in the New York studio

events.n: signed by both artists at his request
events.q: He wrote to the de Koonings, requested they both sign this card, which they returned in an addressed stamped envelope Dan included.

events.n: envelope in which the signed card was returned
events.q: the envelope, dated 1985 and postmarked from Hicksville, Long Island
